assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square albedo material texture for Nautilus painterly 3D architecture, one metre of pale New England dressed granite. Primary request: original hand-painted cool buff-grey granite with quiet warm cream and blue-grey mineral flecks and subtle broad brush variation, restrained gouache/oil game texture matching a warm illustrated tactical architecture collection. Composition: perfectly flat front-facing orthographic material swatch filling every pixel, uniform physical scale across the image, all four edges seamlessly tileable. A single unjointed dressed stone surface; no blocks or mortar lines, no borders, objects, lettering, symbols, watermarks or relief silhouette. Lighting: flat diffuse neutral albedo, no baked directional light, highlights, shadows, vignette or ambient occlusion. Materials: small soft irregular mineral grains grouped into broad readable painted values, gently worked stone rather than photorealistic noise, no cracks or major damage. Palette: light warm grey granite with low contrast, suitable for tinting under dynamic lighting and for columns, lintels and long market facades. Opaque square image.
